import unittest
from textkit.slugify import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_length_limit(self):
        long_text = 'This is a very long text that should be truncated to fit the length limit'
        expected_slug = 'this-is-a-very-long-text-that-should-be-truncated-to-fi'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(long_text), expected_slug)

    def test_accents_and_special_letters(self):
        text = 'Straße'
        expected_slug = 'strasse'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(text), expected_slug)

    def test_symbols_apostrophes_digits(self):
        text = "It's 2023!"
        expected_slug = 'its-2023'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(text), expected_slug)

    def test_separator(self):
        text = 'This is a test'
        expected_slug = 'this-is-a-test'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(text), expected_slug)

    def test_stopwords(self):
        text = 'The quick brown fox'
        expected_slug = 'quick-brown-fox'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(text), expected_slug)

    def test_unique_slug(self):
        text = 'Unique slug'
        expected_slug = 'unique-slug'
        self.assertEqual(slugify(text), expected_slug)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
